list.notConfigured: Livestreaming isn't set up on this server yet.

broadcast.title: Go live
broadcast.endedRemotely: The stream was ended — the connection was lost for too long, or you went live from another device.
broadcast.cameraDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow camera and microphone for this site, then reload the page.
broadcast.tipScreen: Keep this page open with the screen on — phones pause the camera when the screen locks or you switch apps. A chest or arm mount works well.
broadcast.wakeLockUnsupported: This browser can't keep the screen awake automatically — turn off auto-lock while streaming.
broadcast.dataEstimate: Normal quality uses about 0.5–0.7 GB of mobile data per hour.
broadcast.optNotifyHint: Sends a push notification to everyone who can watch.
broadcast.optRecordHint: Saves a replay you can watch later (about 0.6 GB per hour).
broadcast.optLocationHint: Viewers see your route, distance and pace on a map.
broadcast.recordUnavailable: Recording isn't available on this server.
broadcast.lowDisk: Not enough free space on the server to record. Delete old replays or go live without recording.
broadcast.replaySoon: The replay will appear under Replays in a minute.
broadcast.autoLowData: Weak signal — switched to low data.
broadcast.locationError: Couldn't get your location. Check that location access is allowed for this site.

watch.fallbackHls: Compatibility mode — a few seconds behind live.

map.label: Route map
map.waiting: Waiting for the first GPS position…
